answer: The three least-adaptation transfers are: (1) Nextflow-style content-addressed task caching (MECH-NF-TASK-HASH-CACHE) rebuilt as a prompt-run hasher with receipt-verified skip; (2) CWLProv/BagIt-style append-only checksummed run provenance (MECH-CWLPROV-BAGIT) rebuilt onto the receipt+manifest store; (3) SLURM-style explicit afterok dependency predicates (MECH-SLURM-AFTEROK) rebuilt as the catalog dependencies field gated on receipt state. Snakemake's between-workflow cache, DAGMan rescue semantics, Ghidra headless scripting, Wabbajack hashed modlists, xEdit conflict graphs and OpenCue frame chunking transfer with more rewriting. The negative control is Mod Organizer 2's usvfs (MECH-MO2-USVFS): per-process filesystem virtualization by native hook injection cannot be adopted by a prompt-native control plane without replacing its core, which is exactly what the control plane must not do.
